    sc = (dc > 0) - (dc < 0)

    # whose gap was longer, stopping immediately adjacent to the 2.
    n = max(0, min(abs(dr)-1, abs(dc)-1))

    if abs(dr)-1 < abs(dc)-1:
        # Row reached the near side first: finish horizontally.
        dest_c = c2 - sc
        for c in range(ce + sc, dest_c + sc, sc):
            out[re][c] = 3
    elif abs(dc)-1 < abs(dr)-1:
        # Column reached the near side first: finish vertically.
        dest_r = r2 - sr
        for r in range(re + sr, dest_r + sr, sr):
            out[r][ce] = 3
